notes: δέ (s008) takes the *and* before the genitive-absolute clause and δέ (s015) the *and* before *they led*; both connectives are expressed, so no juncture is supplied.
χειραγωγοῦντες keeps the whole discontinuous *led … by the hand*, headed on the verb-root word (rules 15 and 106).
ἀπό is expressed and answers to the preverb of ἀπέπεσαν, so the verb keeps only its verb word.
